caption_used: Distribution of Quantifiers and Operations in Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, and Disjunctive & Conjunctive Reasoning. The Categorical pie chart comprises four segments: Universal Quantifiers (29.07%), Negation (27.91%), Limiter (27.91%), and Existential Quantifiers (15.12%). In the Approximate Number Generation chart, Comparative Relationships constitute the largest share at approximately 48%, followed by Approximate Quantities at 33.26% and Absolute Absence at 18.71%. The Disjunctive & Conjunctive chart shows a near-even split, with Conjunctive slightly dominating at 54.51% over Disjunctive at 45.49%.

Finally, the Disjunctive & Conjunctive chart displays five segments, with Conjunctive colored pink accounting for approximately 54.51% and Disjunctive colored light blue representing 45.49%.
